name: There's an AI

sources.title: Homepage — live 'There's an AI' curated AI tools directory with many categories and a Submit link
Submit route — gated by sign-in: 'To prevent spam, some actions require being signed in' (Google OAuth, free)

requirements: AI tool — directory is AI-only across ~70 categories (audio, image, video, dev tools, SEO, dating, face-swap, etc.)
Free Google sign-in required before the submit form is shown
Sponsored 'Ad' slots exist on the homepage, separate from organic listing
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline, description, logo, and best-fit category
workflow: Listing appears under the chosen category once approved
watchFor: Submit page is fully behind OAuth — form fields cannot be inspected without signing in
Domain branding is 'There's an AI' (theresanai.com for the newsletter); the findanaitools.com domain is the live directory
Site footer says © 2024 and top list says '2024' — freshness is uncertain despite live ads
Paid 'Ad' placements interleave with organic listings on the homepage
countsAsLive: The tool appears on a findanaitools.com category page and/or has a dedicated tool card linking out
unknowns: Exact form fields and whether review is manual or instant (form behind OAuth)
Whether organic listings cost anything after sign-in
